Method of Attack: The package uses a novel attack that uses compiled Python code to evade detection. It contains a single file with malicious functionality written into a compiled Python byte code file (PYC) instead of the more commonly scanned Python source code (PY) files. The entry point of the package is found in the __init__.py file, which imports a function from main.py, responsible for the loading of the Python compiled module located in the full.pyc file. The package uses the Importlib function to load the compiled module, an unusual technique likely used to avoid detection.
Impacted Systems: Unspecified, but at least two targets were infected with username and hostname combinations desktop__desktop-7G-Series and Txxxx_Axxxx__LAPTOP-UH9S5HF2.
Attack Vector: Supply-chain attack via the Python Package Index (PyPI)
